Goal! Charlotte FC 1, CF Montréal 0. Idan Toklomati (Charlotte FC) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Allan Saint-Maximin with a cross.

Efraín Morales (CF Montréal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Charlotte FC. Liel Abada replaces Rodolfo Aloko.
Goal! Charlotte FC 2, CF Montréal 0. Liel Abada (Charlotte FC) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Djibril Diani.
Delay in match because of an injury Allan Saint-Maximin (Charlotte FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Substitution, Charlotte FC. Tyger Smalls replaces Allan Saint-Maximin because of an injury.

Substitution, CF Montréal. Olger Escobar replaces Hennadii Synchuk.
